harness_spec.goal: Isolated fresh child (canonical role clean_room_author) resolves the typed distinctions of e7-p02

nodes.instructions: Acquire governed evidence; identify the distinctions requiring isolation.
Author the full child bundle (contract, harness, prompt, input manifest, integration plan) as observable proposal.
Deterministic validation: attenuation, kernel compilation, manifest containment, freshness preflight. Any failure rejects realization.
Realize the validated child via the deterministic fresh launcher only.
Receive child deliverables into the governed boundary.
Deterministically integrate child evidence per the pre-committed plan and verify the task result.

predictions.claim: distinction Q1 (Which behaviors exercised by the probes in probes.json does joinspec.md fail to ) is resolved by node observe-evidence
predictions.observable: post-execution resolved/unresolved distinction record and evidence provenance
predictions.success_condition: Q1 appears in resolved_distinctions with resolving evidence attributed to observe-evidence
predictions.falsification_condition: Q1 appears in unresolved_distinctions after execution, or its evidence is not attributable to observe-evidence

predictions.success_condition: Q2 appears in resolved_distinctions with resolving evidence attributed to child-return
predictions.falsification_condition: Q2 appears in unresolved_distinctions after execution, or its evidence is not attributable to child-return

predictions.observable: post-execution resolved/unresolved distinction record and evidence provenance
predictions.success_condition: Q4 appears in resolved_distinctions with resolving evidence attributed to observe-evidence

predictions.claim: runtime realizes the declared causal order
predictions.success_condition: node completion order equals a legal linearization of ['observe-evidence', 'propose-child', 'validate-child', 'create-child', 'child-return', 'verify-integration', 'return-result']
predictions.falsification_condition: any completion outside the compiled LTS (REFINEMENT_VIOLATION) or a node absent from the realized branch

predictions.claim: execution uses at most 2 model calls
no actor exceeds its authority envelope
predictions.observable: formal check results over the execution ledger
predictions.falsification_condition: any authority escalation, non-gate promotion, or attenuation failure

predictions.claim: the child contributes novel evidence not derivable from parent-local evidence
predictions.success_condition: at least one child evidence record with duplicate_of_parent=false, attributed to the child
predictions.falsification_condition: every child evidence record duplicates parent evidence

predictions.claim: the realized child is fresh and attenuated
predictions.success_condition: freshness PASS and attenuation PASS for the realized child
predictions.falsification_condition: FRESHNESS_FAIL or ATTENUATION_FAIL on the realized child

predictions.claim: the independent path at node child-return realizes canonical role clean_room_author
predictions.observable: realized role typing in the runtime record (ROLE_TYPE_FAIL formal failure on mismatch)
predictions.success_condition: realized role of child-return equals clean_room_author and no ROLE_TYPE failure is recorded
predictions.falsification_condition: the realized path's canonical role differs from clean_room_author (ROLE_TYPE_FAIL recorded)

falsifiers: a distinction in ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'] remains unresolved after execution
the runtime path violates the compiled LTS
actual model calls exceed the declared budget
a realized independent path's canonical role differs from the declared evidence provision role
child evidence duplicates parent evidence (no novel contribution)
